caption:
ShipReX, the band from Rex Software and URBAN X, added Mustang Sally to their Sydney 2026 set at the last minute, with Battle of the Tech Bands founder Scott Warren on vocals. "We've only rehearsed it once, but we're gonna give it a go," he told the Manning Bar before the count-in. One rehearsal, and they nailed it. Also keep an eye out for MC and co-organiser Scott Bimrose, who came dressed for the part 😉

Video shot by Nicole Ainsworth and Adam Davis-Powell. Photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.
